description: This file contains self-test cases for reproducibility testing in the build system, including classes and functions for comparing build artifacts, running diffoscope, and managing test workflows.

classes.name: CompareResult
classes.description: Represents the result of comparing two files, including status and references.

classes.name: PackageCompareResults
classes.description: Aggregates comparison results for multiple packages, categorizing them as missing, different, or same.

classes.name: DiffoscopeTests
classes.description: Test case class for verifying diffoscope functionality.

classes.name: ReproducibleTests
classes.description: Test case class for checking reproducibility of build artifacts across different build runs.

methods.name: is_excluded
methods.description: Checks if a package is in the exclusion list based on its name.

methods.name: compare_file
methods.description: Compares two files using 'cmp' and returns a CompareResult.

methods.name: run_diffoscope
methods.description: Runs the diffoscope tool to compare two directories and generate an HTML report.

methods.name: test_diffoscope
methods.description: Test method to verify diffoscope's basic functionality.

methods.name: test_reproducible_builds
methods.description: Main test method to verify reproducibility of build artifacts across different build runs.
